atoms.text:
On the map, you can see the countries that are part of the United Kingdom (UK): England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland.
Often, the UK is called “The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland”. “Great Britain” refers to the bigger island group of three countries located in the East. Northern Ireland is not part of it.

hint.text: Great Britain isn't called “great” to express that the country is amazing. The term “great” was added to differentiate Britain from the northern region of France which is called Brittany.

atoms.b:
The island of Ireland is made up of two countries:
Northern Ireland is the ((++northern southern)) part of the island. The other country is called the “Republic of Ireland”. The capital city of the Republic of Ireland is called ((++Dublin London)). In 1919, Ireland decided to become independent from the UK. The UK didn't like that and a war started between them. The war ended in 1921.

((++Northern_Ireland Southern_Ireland)) decided to remain within the UK, but the rest of the island didn't and now became the “Irish Free State”. In 1937, the Republic of Ireland was founded and it ((++is_not is)) part of the UK anymore.

hint.sound: <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>independent</lang> bedeutet unabhängig. <lang xml:lang='en-GB'>to remain</lang> bedeutet verbleiben.

atoms.text: London is not only the capital city of England, but it's also the capital city of the United Kingdom. Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland have their own capital cities too: Cardiff, Edinburgh and Belfast.

atoms.a: What's the capital city of the UK?

instruction.text: Lies den Text und beantworte anschließend die Frage.

atoms.text: The United Kingdom is surrounded by different bodies of water. The North Sea to the East, the Atlantic Ocean to the West and the North, and the English Channel to the South. The Irish Sea touches the coast of each country in the UK. The Celtic Sea is not connected to Northern Ireland or Scotland.

atoms.text: The flag of the United Kingdom is called the Union Jack. Its design is a combination of the flags of England, Scotland and Northern Ireland. The Union Jack was created in 1801 when Wales was still a part of England. That's why the flag of Wales is not included in the Union Jack.
